fixture.type: Storage-shaped direct insertion into a newly migrated owned temporary database. Each case has a separate private principal/workspace/logical launch/document; revision0 has an empty artifact, remaining revisions have one signature and deterministic ASCII comment payload. Full artifacts, revision rows, receipt original requests/outcomes and TERMINAL admission original requests are actually stored. All IDs/contents are authored fixtures.
fixture.accounting: Exact Store.persist formula summed per revision: 2*original_request_bytes + stored_outcome_bytes + stored_artifact_bytes +8192. Set recorded workspace accounting to this recomputed total and independently query actual table lengths/counts. This is accounted logical payload including metadata reserve, not physical PostgreSQL size or artifact scan bytes alone.
fixture.sizing: For N rows calculate exact zero-padding charges, then use floor((target_accounted_bytes-base_charge)/(2*N)) ASCII comment bytes. The padding adds twice per artifact/outcome and twice to revision1's SOURCE request. Remaining budget below2*N bytes is reported, not hidden. Source stays<=32768 bytes, artifact/outcome each<=1MiB, private request IDs<=4096 and args<=256KiB.
fixture.semantics_exclusion: No claim that these4096 rows were admitted by the Java/Alloy validator or represent a reachable sequence of accepted UI edits. Direct fixture insertion bypasses admission/identifier/trivia correspondence. This profile measures the actual store/CLI resource behavior under structurally valid database rows and exact accounting; maximum semantically accepted history construction remains outside this finite resource claim.
fixture.permissions: Migration/control and every fixture/read/cleanup statement go through existing sql_connections and pinned SQLeanParser. No production source/schema/routing policy change and no live corpus data mutation. Only generated allow_sql_test_<32hex> database may be created/dropped; cleanup confirms absence through the same proxy.

execution.entry: Gate-local test harness calls actual allow_documents.cli.main, dispatch and Store.validation_context; only Store factory/private test scope and existing connection alias choose the registered temporary database. Actual canonical proxy/allow_app role and production read-only snapshot/JSON checks remain.
execution.supervision: One newly owned process session per sample; writer and bounded pipe readers run concurrently with deadline monitoring. Kill only this session on timeout/overflow; os.wait4 reaps it and yields per-child kernel peak RSS/CPU. Repeated samples never reuse a CLI process. No HTTP/browser benchmark overlaps this phase.
execution.instrumentation: Connection wrapper returns the unchanged psycopg cursor. Immediately after the complete history SELECT returns and before production iteration, record pgresult.ntuples, column format, exact sum of raw field lengths, /proc memory high water and inspection time. Computing raw length scans each already-resident value once without retaining a list; this adds disclosed CPU/transient-copy overhead. The harness/unittest.mock/control metadata adds memory versus bare production. Results are conservative instrumented component observations, not latency acceptance.
execution.retained_buffer_claim: For successful nonempty samples, all N rows must already reside in libpq pgresult before iteration. With text bytea format, exact raw value bytes must equal2*actual_artifact_bytes+2*N. This measures raw payload only, not libpq allocator overhead. Cursor is explicitly client-buffered, never described as streaming.
metrics: actual row counts and stored byte totals

pass_conditions: Frozen input root remains unchanged before/after each case and at final cleanup; live proxy identity remains the same valid pinned sealed-image generation.
Each successful sample has exact nonce/document/base/head/artifact/inventory and bounded framing, exact unchanged AS/CPU limits, closed connection and required buffer/resource metrics.

A resource-limited sample may be classified RESOURCE_LIMIT_FAIL_CLOSED only for the external wall deadline, kernel resource termination or observed MemoryError returned as bounded UNAVAILABLE. It cannot return partial OK context. Such a sample does not establish full-quota availability or success latency.

Every case is reported, including failure and measured sizes. Missing metrics, unexpected non-resource errors, overflow, wrong data, source mutation, missed case or failed cleanup blocks this finite profile.
Drop and confirm absence of only the newly owned temporary database; retain raw output/telemetry/kernel records and hashes. No valid-corpus or benchmark success follows from this profile.
prior_evidence: Existing22 focused context tests plus22 legacy tests establish logical-full-quota readability/nonmutation separately. This profile supplements resource scaling and does not replace those tests.
